title: Field Road Transformer-GNN Data Pipeline
summary: A hybrid transformer-and-GNN model for detecting field roads in remote-sensing imagery, including a data-processing pipeline with augmentation utilities. Its dataaugmenter/functional.py module uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer (via SingleTableMetadata) alongside SMOTE/ADASYN to rebalance imbalanced tabular field-road data.
